findings.summary: maskPhoneInput treats any deleted separator as a Backspace and removes the digit before the caret; a forward Delete over '-' or ')' does the same, so the user loses a digit they did not select.
findings.failure_scenario: Field holds '(11) 91234-5678', caret right before '-', user presses Delete. Browser reports '(11) 912345678' with caret 10; maskPhoneInput returns '(11) 91235-678' (digit '4' removed). Confirmed with a scratch probe in the run temp dir. Backspace over '-' gives the same result by design (see the comment above the function); the helper receives no inputType, so Delete and Backspace cannot be told apart. Not corrected: the fix needs a signature change (pass the input type) and sits in a helper the frontend unit consumes.

(2) Run pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/imageSignature.test.ts tests/unit/contactFormat.test.ts tests/api/brandRoutes.test.ts tests/unit/pdfRenderer.test.ts tests/api/preferenceRoutes.test.ts and pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts. (3) brandRoutes API test should cover: PNG, JPG, SVG, text renamed .png, 2.1 MB and exactly 2 MB, 1200 px refusal, 3 MB body -> 413 payload_too_large, invalid fields -> validation_failed with nothing saved.

Server does not resize logos: it refuses PNG/JPEG with a longer side above 600 px (422 logo_invalid). The frontend brandLogoImage must reduce to 600 px on the longer side in the same format, and send mimeType exactly 'image/png' or 'image/jpeg' (other declared types are refused) with bare base64 (no data: prefix).
imageSignature checks only the leading bytes; it does not prove the whole file decodes. The PDF logo draw must sit inside try/catch and fall back to no logo.

preferenceRepository.readAll was removed and replaced by readKeys(keys). Checked by this review: no remaining importer in server, shared, src, tests or scripts; only brandService and preferenceService call readKeys.
Phone mask: a forward Delete over the mask separator removes the preceding digit (same as Backspace by design). Acceptable for now; a later cleanup can pass the input type to maskPhoneInput.
